en.How many landmasses to build. Channels b: How many landmasses to build. Channels between them stay narrow enough for a starter road to bridge.
How many tall ranges sit on each island.
en.How far apart the main ranges sit. Close: How far apart the main ranges sit. Close ranges may touch.
en.Short snaky ranges scattered on the flat: Short snaky ranges scattered on the flat land.
en.How many rivers start in the mountains a: How many rivers start in the mountains and walk toward the coast. This is a bias, not an exact count.
en.Width of the rivers, from the game defau: Width of the rivers, from the game default up to about four times that.
en.How many lakes are stamped. Even Many st: How many lakes are stamped. Even Many stays fewer than a packed vanilla map.
en.Stamp size. Varying mixes several sizes: Stamp size. Varying mixes several sizes on one map. The other settings use one size.
en.Temperate keeps the normal ground and tr: Temperate keeps the normal ground and trees. Diverse paints large locales of forest, sand, tropical grass, and moss.
en.Roads the game builds between towns at t: Roads the game builds between towns at the start.
en.None skips town placement. Default uses: None skips town placement. Default uses the game's town sliders.
en.None skips industry placement. Default u: None skips industry placement. Default uses the game's industry density.
en.All chains uses the full economy and rai: All chains uses the full economy and raises how many industries are placed at the start. It does not guarantee every industry on every seed.
